consumption.lookup: read-only lookup by exact proposal_digest before V1.1 after_tool
consumption.mark_consumed: only after V1.1 after_tool returns successfully
consumption.relationship: provider consumption mirrors successful adapter acknowledgement but does not mutate adapter internals
consumption.replay: consumed proposal digest cannot be acknowledged again

lifecycle.replay: reject consumed digest and conflicting duplicate outcome identity
lifecycle.reset: clear provider-owned records and consumed set only
lifecycle.restore: validate schema, unique keys, digest consistency, and consumed subset before replace
lifecycle.retry: failed downstream acknowledgement leaves provider record unconsumed
lifecycle.snapshot: records, consumed digests, provider schema version, binding identity

population.duplicate_rule: same digest and byte-equivalent record is idempotent; conflicting duplicate fails closed
population.write_time: immediately after authoritative before_decide returns the proposal record and before tool execution

provider_api.mark_consumed: mark_consumed(proposal_digest: str, outcome_event_identity: Mapping[str, Any]) -> None
